agricultural: Agricultural land shows large, contiguous parcels with uniform texture and regular geometric field boundaries. It differs from golf course by lacking manicured fairways and sand traps; tennis court by having no court lines or net; runway by having no pavement markings and being agricultural rather than aviation infrastructure.
airplane: Airplanes appear as elongated metallic objects with distinct fuselage, wings, and tail, parked on hardstand areas. They are distinguished from runway by being discrete movable objects rather than linear pavement; harbor shows water and docks rather than aircraft; agricultural fields lack any metallic aircraft shapes.
baseballdiamond: Baseball diamonds are characterized by their distinctive diamond-shaped infield with raised pitcher's mound, outfield grass, and surrounding dirt. They differ from tennis court by having diamond geometry rather than rectangular with net; golf course by having sports diamond rather than fairways and bunkers; harbor by having sports infrastructure rather than water and docks.
beach: Beaches appear as narrow, light-toned sandy strips along water bodies, often with visible wave patterns and shoreline curvature. They contrast with chaparral by having sand rather than dense shrub vegetation; agricultural fields show crops rather than sandy shorelines; forests show tree cover rather than beach sand.
buildings: Buildings are characterized by rectangular footprints with visible roofs, shadows, and regular spatial arrangements in urban blocks. They differ from parking lot by being roofed structures rather than open vehicle storage; dense residential by being commercial structures rather than housing units; runway by having no pavement markings and being vertical structures.
chaparral: Chaparral appears as dense, low, dark-green shrub vegetation with irregular edges covering hillsides, showing rough texture. It contrasts with beach by having vegetation rather than sand; river by being land vegetation rather than water channel; tennis court by having wild scrub rather than maintained court surface.
denseresidential: Dense residential areas show small housing units packed closely together with narrow streets, tiny yards, and uniform block patterns. They differ from mobile home park by having permanent foundations rather than trailer units; tennis court by having housing rather than sports court; buildings are larger commercial structures rather than houses.
forest: Forests appear as extensive areas with dense, tall tree cover, dark green canopy with rough, uneven texture and no visible ground. They contrast with mobile home park by lacking buildings and roads; dense residential by having tree cover rather than housing; agricultural by having natural tree cover rather than crop rows.
freeway: Freeways are wide linear strips of paved concrete with multiple lanes, clear lane markings, and overpass intersections. They differ from overpass by being ground-level continuous pavement rather than elevated structures; runway by being narrower with lane divisions; river by being paved corridor rather than water channel.
golfcourse: Golf courses are large green areas with mowed fairways, lighter roughs, sand bunkers, and small water hazards. They contrast with agricultural by having scattered bunkers rather than uniform crop rows; baseballdiamond by having fairways rather than sports diamond; river by having land features rather than water channel.
harbor: Harbors show calm water areas enclosed by docks, piers, ships, and cranes, with visible boundaries and artificial shoreline modifications. They differ from parking lot by containing water and vessels rather than vehicles; baseballdiamond by having water infrastructure rather than sports field; storage tanks by having water rather than metallic containers.
intersection: Intersections show cross-shaped road junctions with clear pavement markings, turn lanes, and traffic islands. They contrast with overpass by being ground-level junctions rather than elevated structures; river by being road features rather than water features; runway by being local junction rather than linear pavement.
mediumresidential: Medium residential consists of moderate-sized houses on medium lots with regular spacing, tree-lined streets, and observable driveways. It differs from mobile home park by having permanent houses rather than trailer units; dense residential by having larger yards; sparse residential by having more space and vegetation between houses.
mobilehomepark: Mobile home parks show rows of small, narrow rectangular trailer units arranged in dense, uniform clusters with narrow access roads. They contrast with dense residential by having no permanent foundations; medium residential by having trailer units rather than houses; forest by having buildings and roads rather than tree cover.
overpass: Overpasses are elevated road segments supported by pillars, crossing above other roads or terrain, with visible ramps and shadows. They differ from freeway by being raised structures rather than ground-level pavement; intersection by being elevated crossing rather than ground junction; runway by having pillars and elevation rather than surface pavement.
parkinglot: Parking lots are flat, open areas with visible rows of parked vehicles in organized lanes with painted markings. They contrast with buildings by having open vehicle storage rather than roofed structures; harbor by having vehicles rather than ships and water; mobile home park by having vehicles rather than trailer units.
river: Rivers appear as narrow, linear, dark water bodies with sinuous curves and riparian vegetation along banks. They differ from intersection by being natural water features rather than road junctions; chaparral by being water channel rather than shrub vegetation; freeway by being water rather than paved corridor.
runway: Runways are long, straight, wide paved strips with clear parallel markings, end zones, and no intersecting cross streets. They contrast with airplane by being pavement infrastructure rather than discrete aircraft objects; freeway by being wider with aircraft markings; buildings by having horizontal pavement rather than vertical structures.
sparseresidential: Sparse residential shows widely spaced houses surrounded by large vegetated lots, with visible driveways and sparse road networks. It differs from dense residential by having much larger lots and more vegetation; mobile home park by having houses rather than trailers; chaparral by having houses and lawns rather than wild scrub.
storagetanks: Storage tanks appear as large circular metallic structures with domed or flat roofs, arranged in clusters, with visible shadows and connecting pipes. They contrast with mobile home park by having industrial structures rather than trailer units; harbor by having metallic containers rather than water and docks; tennis court by having circular structures rather than rectangular court.
tenniscourt: Tennis courts are rectangular playing areas with visible nets, court lines, and smooth surfaces, often with surrounding fences. They differ from dense residential by being sports courts rather than housing units; baseballdiamond by being rectangular rather than diamond; agricultural by having maintained court surface rather than crop fields.
